title: Development
description: Python and JavaScript projects with GitHub: PyPI, npm, GitHub and DuckDuckGo open, everything else closed.

de.title: Entwicklung
de.description: Python- und JavaScript-Projekte mit GitHub: PyPI, npm, GitHub und DuckDuckGo offen, alles andere zu.

notes: Compilers and interpreters newer than the image's (Python with uv, Node with TypeScript, Go, also rust, jdk, dotnet, zig, cc): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox): sandbox-ai toolchain add python && sandbox-ai toolchain add node && sandbox-ai toolchain add go once, then --toolchain python --toolchain node --toolchain go on the command line, or into the running sandbox: sandbox-ai toolchain attach RUN python. Its registries are the ones this preset opens.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
